captions.detailed: A tabletop arcade cabinet model featuring a dark grey/black main body, a tilted screen, and three colorful control buttons on the front panel. A small black cylindrical control knob is mounted on the top surface, designed to rotate continuously about its vertical axis. On the side, a grey coin acceptor panel is attached, containing a small dark grey coin return flap that rotates on a horizontal revolute hinge.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a tabletop arcade machine with a dark cabinet, three colored buttons (red, yellow, and blue), a top-mounted cylindrical control knob that rotates continuously, and a side-mounted coin mechanism featuring a revolute coin return flap.
captions.factory: The arcade cabinet is built from extruded 2D profiles and boolean operations to form the side panels, screen bezel, and control deck. Colored buttons are constructed as cylinders and placed on the control deck. A separate control knob on top is modeled as a cylinder. The coin acceptor is composed of a rectangular box with cutouts, while the coin return flap is modeled as a small box and attached via a revolute joint to the acceptor panel.
